provenance.method: GFN2-xTB scalars bundled with each QC-accepted geometry
provenance.note: Values were not recomputed here. They are used exactly as bundled and are audited, not trusted a priori.

q_metal.description: GFN2-xTB partial charge on the lanthanide centre.

q_donor_mean.description: Mean GFN2-xTB partial charge over the selected coordinating donors.

q_donor_std.description: Population standard deviation of the donor partial charges.

dipole_magnitude.description: Norm of the complex dipole vector; the frame-dependent components dipole_x/y/z are never used.

complex_total_energy.description: GFN2-xTB total energy of the whole complex as bundled.

duplicate_columns.finding: bit-identical on every row where both are observed; the bundle reports one energy under two names, so only the total-energy column is used

homo_eV.reason: All-null in the bundle; the manifest records that the existing extxyz payloads lack individual frontier-orbital energies.

lumo_eV.reason: All-null in the bundle; same reason as homo_eV.

homo_lumo_gap_eV.reason: All-null in the bundle; requires homo_eV and lumo_eV.

binding_energy_eV.reason: All-null in the bundle; requires free-ion, free-ligand and free-fill reference xTB energies that were queued (features/xtb_reference_calculation_queue.csv, calculation_status=not_run_requires_reference_xtb) but never run.

strain_energy_eV.reason: All-null in the bundle; requires a free-ligand reference geometry and single point at the bound conformation.

geometry_xtb_energy_eV.reason: Row-level column present but all-null in the bundle.

ligand_level_electronic.reason: No free-ligand electronic calculation exists in the bundle. Every available electronic quantity is a property of the metal complex, so a ligand-only electronic block (ligand dipole, ligand HOMO/LUMO, ligand partial charges) cannot be constructed. The E1 arm is therefore declared unavailable rather than filled with complex-level values relabelled as ligand-level.

solvation_energy.reason: No implicit-solvent single points are bundled and the extraction conditions are not encoded in the geometry assets.

interaction_energy.reason: Requires fragment references (ion plus ligands at the complex geometry); see binding_energy_eV.

energy_definition.equation: elec__odd__delta_complex_total_energy_eV = E_total(complex with metal A) - E_total(complex with metal B), emitted only when both complexes share coreCN, n_ligs, inner_sphere_anion, fill_ligand, n_fill and metal_ox.
energy_definition.assumptions: This is a total-energy difference, NOT a binding, complexation or interaction energy: the bundle contains no free-ion and no free-ligand reference calculation, so no thermodynamic cycle can be closed. The difference retains an unknown additive constant per metal pair (the free-ion reference difference). That constant is bounded in this cohort: the between-metal-pair spread of mean dE is smaller than the within-pair ligand-dependent spread, so the column is not merely a metal-pair label. It is still redundant with the LN family by construction and must not be read as a stability constant.
